items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb von zwei Wochen ab seiner Zustellung Einspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Stadt Musterquellen – Bußgeldstelle.
items.computation: The attached Zustellungsurkunde (page 2) records the actual delivery date as 21.11.2026 (a Saturday), filled in by the mail carrier ('zugest. 21.11.2026'). This is formal service under §182 ZPO, so the real recorded delivery date governs rather than any 3-day fiction. Under §187 Abs.1 BGB / §43 StPO (applicable via §46 OWiG), the day of delivery itself is not counted; the 2-week period starts 22.11.2026. Under §188 Abs.2 BGB / §43 StPO, a period stated in weeks ends on the day of the second week whose name matches the day of the triggering event (Saturday) i.e. Saturday 05.12.2026. Since 05.12.2026 is a Saturday and 06.12.2026 is a Sunday, under §193 BGB / §43 Abs.2 StPO the deadline shifts to the next working day. No NRW public holiday falls in this window, so the deadline moves to Monday 07.12.2026.

items.title: Pay the total fine (Gesamtbetrag), but only once the Bescheid is final
items.quote: Zahlen Sie erst, wenn dieser Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist, und dann binnen zwei Wochen auf das Konto DE29 5135 0025 0002 1403 00.
items.computation: Payment is explicitly conditional on the Bescheid becoming rechtskräftig (final), which happens if no Einspruch is filed by the deadline of 07.12.2026; finality then begins 08.12.2026. Counting analogously to the Einspruch period (day of the triggering event not counted, period ends on the matching weekday two weeks later): 08.12.2026 is a Tuesday, so the 2-week payment period would end Tuesday 22.12.2026, which is not a weekend or NRW holiday, so no shift is needed. This date is only valid if no Einspruch is lodged; if an Einspruch is filed, the payment obligation and its deadline are suspended/altered and cannot be computed from this letter alone.

warnings: The sender's email address ('bussgeld@stadt-musterquellen-bußgelds.example') uses a reserved '.example' domain and an unusual spelling, which does not look like a genuine municipal domain — verify the sender's real contact details before responding or paying.

The Einspruch deadline was calculated from the actual delivery date (21.11.2026) noted by hand on the attached envelope scan/Zustellungsurkunde; the person should check this date against their own copy of the delivery record, since an error here directly shifts the legal deadline.

The payment due date (2026-12-22) is only valid if no Einspruch is filed by 2026-12-07; if an objection is lodged, no payment is due under the terms described and the actual date of finality may differ from the one assumed here.
